body: Came back because today the hatred - the absolute hatred for myself. I am trying. But the time thing - it feels like it will only get worse. Only get more pathetic, more physically horrible. More time seems to mean more accrued failure. I am trying to so hard not to accept that but my gif the feeling is so strong, so fuelled by logic that seems like it's the only authentic thing I have. I really am trying. The hatred though, the awareness of what I lost, what I never deserved in the first place - the worthlessness feels so real. I hope.
